title: 第5章  果然如此
content_zh:
“砰……砰砰……”
苏烬生刚刚回到房屋中坐下，便听外面敲门声再次响起，不由得眉头轻皱。
“不会是那个贱女人又回来了吧！”
口中喃喃自语间，起身走至院子内，
入目的是一位同样穿着杂役弟子服饰的弟子。
“苏烬生，杂役总管发布任务，命你前往山脉外围寻找百灵草五十株！”
“太阳落山之前，上交至总管手中！”
这位杂役弟子说完之后，便将一枚弟子令牌交给了他，随即便头也不回的离开了。
苏烬生握着任务令牌，脸上露出一副疑惑的神色。
这百灵草乃是炼制凝气丹必备灵药，十分常见，通常生长在山脉的外围。
只是，这采取百灵草的任务通常都会交给炼气四重境的杂役弟子完成。
因为在山脉外围极有可能会碰见一级初期乃至一级中期妖兽。
炼气四重境武者不但能战胜一级初期妖兽，还能在一级中期妖兽手中逃跑，绝不会有生命危险。
如若派出炼气四重境以下的武者，将会有严重的生命危险。
然而如今却派刚突破炼气三重境不久的他前往。
看来，胡荣已经知道他将于彦君斩杀一事了。
所以便利用杂役总管老爹的职务之便为于彦君报仇。
据他所知，如今的胡荣也不过只是炼气四重境而已。
凭借他如今的实力，丝毫不惧。
纵使在山脉外围碰到一级中期妖兽，也有十足的把握逃走。

略微思索之后，苏烬生便关上院门，朝着山脉外围走去。
紫慕神山与山脉相隔很近，只有几里的路程，很快便可到达。
苏烬生先去之前的那个山洞中，将张霖身上的凝气丹以及下品灵石给收了起来。
上一次拯救林月舒心切，还未来得及搜刮，便快速离开了。
一枚凝气丹，十枚下品灵石，对于如今的他来说，还是十分有必要跑这一趟的。
一刻钟后，苏烬生出现在了山脉的外围，脚步不由得放缓几分，心生警惕。
其一是为了防止妖兽突袭。
其二便是担心胡荣设下了什么陷阱埋伏。
虽然他能够战胜练气四重境武者，但也是不敢有半点大意。
步伐轻盈，目光扫视四周，提防的同时，观察着百灵草的踪迹。
“苏烬生！你的死期到了！！”
爆喝声响起，一道高壮的身影从一侧快步走上前来，脸上带着浓浓的愤怒之色！
苏烬生看到来人之后，双眼微微眯起，露出一副果然如此的模样。
如他猜测的一样，这任务只是将他引出紫幕神山的一个陷阱而已。
目的就是杀他为于彦君报仇而已。
虽然紫幕神山禁止内斗，但却允许反击，并且，杀人之后还不会受到什么处罚。
相反，率先挑起事端的人，无论是成功还是失败，都会受到惩罚。
也正是因为如此，这胡荣才会将他引到山脉之中动手。
毕竟，伪造成妖兽撕咬至死的痕迹，还是十分容易的。
胡荣身材魁梧，相貌粗糙，皮肤黝黑，双目犀利，俨然一副凶神恶煞的模样。

手中一柄凡阶下品剑刃闪烁寒光，炼气四重境气息散发，锋芒毕露！
“于彦君你都敢废，难道你不知道他是我的人吗？”
胡荣迈动沉闷步伐，双目如猎人看猎物一般，死死盯着苏烬生，脸上怒意涌现。
“今日，我便要让你承受百倍的痛苦，来为于彦君报仇！”
音落，步伐骤然加快，手中剑刃挥动，凌厉气息弥漫，径直杀去！
在他看来，苏烬生不过只是一个废物而已，即便是能够战胜于彦君，也是如此。
毕竟，于彦君也不过才炼气三重境而已，与他相比，相差十万八千里，根本不能相提并论。
“莲花剑舞！”
手中剑刃挥舞到极致，寒光频现，速度极快，凡阶中级武技，施展的凌厉尽致！
苏烬生嘴角翘起了丝丝弧度，丝毫不惧，这莲花剑舞也是当初他入门之时修炼的一门武技。
熟练程度，早已炉火纯青，无人能及。
这胡荣的莲花剑舞看似凶猛凌厉，杀意频现，实则朴华无实，破绽百出，简直不堪一击！
“咻！”
剑风入耳，利刃已至身前。
苏烬生动了，中品凡器瞬间出现手中，蓄势已久的灵气瞬间迸发，利剑颤鸣！
“铮！”
“咻！！”
一道剑气好似脱弓利箭一般，径直奔袭！
“啊！！”
只听一道惨叫之声响起，胡荣手中兵刃落地，与之一起的，还有四根手指！

顿时间，血流如柱，整个魁梧的身躯也是接连后退数步！
一双眼眸瞪大，仿佛看到了什么难以置信的事情一般，死死盯着苏烬生！
他，他的凡阶中级武技，竟然被轻易破解了！
怎么会？
怎么会这样？
苏烬生不是炼气三重境武者吗？怎么可能会是他炼气四重境的对手！
“不可能！”
“你的实力怎么可能会这么强！！”
一时间，难以接受的声音从其口中响起，身影也不由得后退几步。
“你难道不知道，莲花剑舞的最大弱点就是握剑之处吗？”
苏烬生如看跳梁小丑一般看着胡荣，脸上满是不屑的神色，开口出声道。
这莲花剑舞的攻势好似莲花一般，看似威力强悍，实则中心无守，轻而易举便可破解。
若是对付一些门外汉那是绰绰有余了，但是用来对付他，那简直是自寻死路！
苏烬生体内灵气涌动，提剑迈步上前，他可没有打算放过这个胡荣。
毕竟，当初这个胡荣也没少欺辱他！
当初自己被打断腿，想要上告宗门时，胡荣便跳出来威胁。
若是他敢上告的话，就让林月舒再无安稳日子！
一番权衡利弊后，苏烬生便放弃了上告，毕竟，即便是上告，也只是惩罚一下于彦君而已。
并不会造成什么太大的伤害损失，反而，对林月舒将会是无穷尽的麻烦。
“你这个废物，竟然知道莲花剑舞的弱点！”

胡荣牙关紧咬，丝丝鲜血从口中溢出，怒目圆瞪，恶狠狠出声道。
“还敢伤我！”
“你等着！我会让你知道什么是生不如死的！！”
苏烬生则是不以为意，脸上露出一副自嘲的表情。
没想到，短短一年的时间，就已经让所有人忘记他曾经是内门弟子第一人了！
当初，他可是一步步崛起，各种武技都有所掌握，且尤为熟练，非常人所能够相比的！
也正是因为如此，他才有信心越级战斗！
“你不会让我知道什么是生不如死的！”
“反倒是我，会让你知道什么是生不如死的！”
苏烬生饶有兴致出声，骤然间，眼中寒光乍现，一个箭步冲上前去。
人未到，剑已至！
“噗！”
一条胳膊腾空而起，在空中划出一个弧度后落至地面！
一时间，血流如柱！
“你，你竟然敢对我动手！！”
“难道，你不知道，我爹是杂役总管吗？”
胡荣一手捂着断臂，鲜血顺着手指流淌，面色狰狞，双目瞪大，咬牙切齿出声。
“你完了！”
“我爹一定不会放过你的！”
苏烬生却是置若罔闻，仿佛未曾听到一般，手中剑刃再次挥动，又是一条胳膊被斩断。

这一次，未曾迟疑，剑刃接连挥动！
“啊！”
“啊！”
“啊……”
一道道惨叫声中，胡荣便已落的和于彦君一样下场，四肢被斩断，丹田破碎。
俨然成为了一个人彘！
“别杀我！”
“别杀我！！”
这一刻，胡荣已经彻底绝望，即便是能活下去，也需要人照料才行。
那苏烬生无情的面目好似恶魔一般，笼罩在心头，若是再不出口求饶，他必死无疑！
好死不如赖活着，他不想死！
只要不死，凭借他爹杂役总管的身份，依旧能够活的很滋润！
“只要你不杀我，我就不让我父亲报复你！”
“我发誓，我发誓！！”
苏烬生衣衫上已经站满鲜血，神色冰冷，丝毫不为所动，因为他知道。
若非自己实力强横，他的下场恐怕会更加惨烈。
利剑上，鲜血如丝线般滴落，寒光利剑闪烁，锋芒尽显！
“嗷~呜……”
狼嚎之声划破天际。
苏烬生手中动作一滞，随即转头望向别处。

只见，一头足有丈高，通体灰色毛发的黑煞狼屹立，一双幽绿的眸子直勾勾的望着这边。
一级初期妖兽，黑煞狼，速度极快，对血腥味十分敏感。
想来，原本就在这附近，被这血腥味吸引来的罢了！
苏烬生见状，嘴角翘起丝丝邪魅之色，双目盯着胡荣，继而出声道。
“好，我不杀你！”
“但能不能活，就看你的造化了！”
胡荣似乎意识到了苏烬生要做什么，心中恐惧爆发，脸上肌肉都在颤抖。
眼中满是绝望之色，求饶道。
“不，不要！”
“不要！！”
苏烬生面带邪魅笑容，将其身上的修炼资源搜刮一番之后，脚下一动，便直接将其踢飞了出去。
身躯刚好落到那黑煞狼的身前！
content_en:
"Bang...bang bang..."
Su Jinsheng had just returned to the house and sat down when he heard the knock on the door again and could not help but frown slightly.
"It's not like that bitch is back!"
While muttering to himself, he stood up and walked to the yard.
The person who entered the scene was a disciple who was also wearing the uniform of a handyman disciple.
"Su Jinsheng, the general manager has issued a mission and ordered you to go to the outskirts of the mountain range to find fifty Lark Grass plants!"
"Send it to the steward before the sun goes down!"
After the handyman disciple finished speaking, he handed him a disciple token and left without looking back.
Su Jinsheng held the mission token with a puzzled look on his face.
This lark grass is a necessary elixir for refining the Qi Condensing Pill. It is very common and usually grows on the periphery of the mountains.
However, the task of collecting lark grass is usually left to the handyman disciples at the fourth level of Qi refining.
Because it is very likely to encounter early level one or even mid level one monsters outside the mountains.
A warrior at the fourth level of Qi Refining can not only defeat the first-level early-stage monsters, but can also escape from the hands of the mid-level first-level monsters without risking his life.
If a warrior below the fourth level of Qi Refining is sent out, his life will be seriously in danger.
However, now he was sent there who had just broken through to the third level of Qi refining.
It seemed that Hu Rong already knew about his execution of Yu Yanjun.
So he took advantage of his position as the handyman to avenge Yu Yanjun.
As far as he knew, Hu Rong was only at the fourth level of Qi refining.
With his current strength, he has no fear at all.
Even if you encounter a mid-level first-level monster outside the mountain range, you will still be able to escape with complete confidence.
After thinking for a moment, Su Jinsheng closed the courtyard door and walked toward the outskirts of the mountain range.
Zimu Shenshan is very close to the mountains, only a few miles away, and can be reached quickly.
Su Jinsheng went to the previous cave first and collected the Qi Condensing Pill and low-grade spiritual stones on Zhang Lin's body.
The last time he rescued Lin Yueshu, he was so eager to save her that he left quickly before he had time to search.
One Qi Condensation Pill and ten low-grade spirit stones. For him now, it is still very necessary to make this trip.
A quarter of an hour later, Su Jinsheng appeared on the outskirts of the mountain range. He couldn't help but slow down a bit, feeling wary.
One is to prevent monster attacks.
The second is that he is worried that Hu Rong has set some traps and ambushes.
Although he was able to defeat the warriors at the fourth level of Qi training, he did not dare to be careless in the slightest.
His steps were light and his eyes scanned the surroundings, watching for traces of lark while being alert.
"Su Jinsheng! Your death has come!!"
There was a loud shout, and a tall figure walked forward quickly from one side, with a strong look of anger on his face!
After Su Jinsheng saw the person coming, he narrowed his eyes slightly, showing that this was indeed the case.
Just as he guessed, this mission was just a trap to lead him out of the Purple Curtain Mountain.
The purpose is to kill him to avenge Yu Yanjun.
Although the Purple Curtain Mountain prohibits internal fighting, it does allow counterattacks, and there will be no punishment for killing people.
On the contrary, those who first stir up trouble will be punished whether they succeed or fail.
It was precisely because of this that Hu Rong led him to the mountains to do something.
After all, it is very easy to fake the traces of a monster biting someone to death.
Hu Rong is tall, rough-looking, dark-skinned, and has sharp eyes, giving him a fierce look.
The blade of a low-grade mortal sword in his hand flashed with cold light, and the aura of the fourth level of Qi Refining was emitted, showing off its sharp edge!
"You dare to destroy Yu Yanjun, don't you know he is mine?"
Hu Rong took dull steps, his eyes were like a hunter looking at his prey, staring at Su Jinsheng, anger emerging on his face.
"Today, I will make you suffer a hundred times the pain to avenge Yu Yanjun!"
The sound fell, the pace suddenly accelerated, the sword in his hand waved, and the sharp aura filled the air., kill directly!
In his opinion, Su Jinsheng was just a waste, even if he could defeat Yu Yanjun.
After all, Yu Yanjun is only at the third level of Qi refining. Compared with him, he is far different and cannot be compared at all.
"Lotus Sword Dance!"
The sword blade in his hand was swung to the extreme, cold light appeared frequently, and the speed was extremely fast. The mortal-level intermediate martial arts were displayed with utmost ferocity!
The corners of Su Jinsheng's mouth curled up, not afraid at all. This lotus sword dance was also a martial art he practiced when he first started.
The level of proficiency has long been perfected and no one can match it.
Hu Rong's lotus sword dance looks fierce and fierce, with frequent murderous intentions, but in fact it is simple and unrealistic, full of flaws, and simply vulnerable!
"Phew!"
The sword wind reached my ears, and the sharp blade was already in front of me.
Su Jin came to life, a middle-grade mortal weapon instantly appeared in his hand, the long-awaited spiritual energy burst out instantly, and the sword trembled!
"Zheng!"
"Whoops!!"
A sword energy rushed straight towards him like a sharp arrow from a bow!
"Ah!!"
Just hearing a scream, the weapon in Hu Rong's hand fell to the ground, along with four fingers!
Suddenly, blood flowed like a column, and the entire burly body also took several steps back!
A pair of eyes widened, staring at Su Jinsheng as if they had seen something unbelievable!
He, his mortal-level intermediate martial arts was easily cracked!
How could it be?
how so?
Isn't Su Jinsheng a warrior at the third level of Qi refining? How could he be his opponent at the fourth level of Qi refining!
"Impossible!"
"How could you be so strong!!"
For a moment, an unacceptable voice sounded from his mouth, and the figure couldn't help but take a few steps back.
"Don't you know that the biggest weakness of the Lotus Sword Dance is where the sword is held?"
Su Jinsheng looked at Hu Rong like a clown, with a look of disdain on his face, and spoke.
This Lotus Sword Dance's offensive is like a lotus flower. It seems to be powerful, but in fact the center is undefended and can be easily broken.
If it were used to deal with some laymen, it would be more than enough, but if it was used to deal with him, it would be simply asking for death!
Su Jinsheng's spiritual energy surged in his body. He raised his sword and stepped forward. He had no intention of letting Hu Rong go.
After all, Hu Rong had also insulted him back then!
When he had his leg broken and wanted to sue the sect, Hu Rong jumped out and threatened.
If he dares to file a lawsuit, Lin Yueshu will no longer have a stable life!
After weighing the pros and cons, Su Jinsheng gave up the appeal. After all, even the appeal would only punish Yu Yanjun.
It won't cause much damage or loss, but will cause endless trouble to Lin Yueshu.
"You loser, you actually know the weakness of Lotus Sword Dance!"
Hu Rong clenched his teeth, and a trace of blood spilled from his mouth. He stared angrily and said viciously.
"How dare you hurt me!"
"Just wait! I will let you know what life is worse than death!!"
Su Jinsheng didn't take it seriously, with a self-deprecating expression on his face.
Unexpectedly, in just one year, everyone has forgotten that he was once the number one inner disciple!
At the beginning, he rose step by step and mastered all kinds of martial arts, and he was particularly proficient in it, which was incomparable to others!
It is precisely because of this that he has the confidence to fight beyond the level!
"You won't let me know what life is worse than death!"
"On the contrary, I will let you know what life is worse than death!"
Su Jinsheng spoke with great interest. Suddenly, a cold light appeared in his eyes, and he rushed forward with a sprint.
Before anyone arrives, the sword has arrived!
"Poof!"
An arm rose into the air, drew an arc in the air, and then fell to the ground!
For a moment, blood flowed like a pillar!
"You, how dare you attack me!!"
"Don't you know that my father is the general manager?"
Hu Rong covered his broken arm with one hand, blood flowing down his handHis fingers were flowing, his face was ferocious, his eyes were wide open, and he was gnashing his teeth.
"You're done!"
"My father will never let you go!"
Su Jinsheng turned a deaf ear, as if he had never heard anything. He swung the sword in his hand again, and another arm was cut off.
This time, without hesitation, the sword blades were waved one after another!
"Ah!"
"Ah!"
"Ah..."
Amidst the screams, Hu Rong suffered the same fate as Yu Yanjun, with his limbs cut off and his Dantian shattered.
He has become a human pig!
"Don't kill me!"
"Don't kill me!!"
At this moment, Hu Rong was completely desperate. Even if he could survive, he still needed someone to take care of him.
Su Jinsheng's ruthless face was like a demon, shrouding his heart. If he didn't beg for mercy, he would definitely die!
It's better to die than live, he doesn't want to die!
As long as he doesn't die, he can still live a prosperous life thanks to his father's status as a handyman!
"As long as you don't kill me, I won't let my father take revenge on you!"
"I swear, I swear!!"
Su Jinsheng's clothes were already covered with blood, and his expression was cold, unmoved at all, because he knew it.
If he hadn't been so powerful, his end would have been even more tragic.
On the sword, blood dripped like threads, and the sword flashed with cold light, showing its sharp edge!
"Ouch~ow..."
The sound of howling wolves pierced the sky.
Su Jinsheng's movements froze, and then he turned his head and looked away.
I saw a black wolf with a height of ten feet and gray hair standing there, looking straight at this side with a pair of green eyes.
The first-level monster beast, the black evil wolf, is extremely fast and very sensitive to the smell of blood.
Come to think of it, I was originally nearby and was attracted by the smell of blood!
When Su Jinsheng saw this, the corners of his mouth turned up with a hint of evil, his eyes stared at Hu Rong, and then he spoke.
"Okay, I won't kill you!"
"But whether you can survive or not depends on your fate!"
Hu Rong seemed to realize what Su Jinsheng was going to do, fear broke out in his heart, and the muscles on his face were trembling.
With despair in his eyes, he begged for mercy.
"No, don't!"
"No!!"
Su Jinsheng had an evil smile on his face. After searching for the training resources on his body, he moved his feet and kicked him away.
The body fell just in front of the black evil wolf!
